population_served: Anyone seeking housing, treatment, shelter, food, transportation, employment, or community services
services: Connects callers to local housing, shelter, treatment, recovery, food, utility, and reentry resources.
eligibility_and_intake: Call or text a ZIP code and describe the caller's needs.
certification_or_authority: Indiana Family and Social Services Administration
availability_note: Available statewide. Local program openings and eligibility vary.

population_served: People seeking addiction treatment or recovery housing in Indiana
services: State provider search for addiction services and recovery housing options.
eligibility_and_intake: Search by location and service, then contact the provider directly.
certification_or_authority: Indiana Family and Social Services Administration
availability_note: Listings do not guarantee an immediate opening.

population_served: People seeking designated recovery residences and providers seeking certification information
services: Recovery residence locator, standards, education, and certification support.
eligibility_and_intake: Use the locator or call for help identifying designated recovery residences.
certification_or_authority: Indiana NARR affiliate
availability_note: INARR does not operate every residence. Contact individual houses for openings.

population_served: Uninsured or underinsured Indiana residents involved with the criminal justice system
services: Funding and access pathway for treatment and recovery support, including eligible recovery residences.
eligibility_and_intake: Eligibility generally involves criminal justice involvement and being uninsured or underinsured. Begin through a participating provider or Indiana 211.
certification_or_authority: Indiana Division of Mental Health and Addiction
availability_note: Funding and provider participation are subject to program rules.

population_served: Adults in recovery, with houses serving men, women, and some parents with children
services: Live vacancy locator and online application for self supporting, substance free Oxford Houses.
eligibility_and_intake: Call the listed house contact for an interview, or submit the online application.
cost_notes: Residents share household expenses. Amounts vary by house.
certification_or_authority: Oxford House, Inc.
availability_note: Use the live locator because vacancies and contact numbers change frequently.

population_served: People preparing to return from incarceration and formerly incarcerated Indiana residents
services: Reentry planning, employment resources, skills training, community transition, and links to local support.
eligibility_and_intake: People currently incarcerated should work with unit staff or a reentry coordinator. Released residents can use the linked resources and Indiana 211.
certification_or_authority: Indiana Department of Correction
availability_note: Housing placements are program and county specific.
